author: Stahly
description:
I've tested the brand-new airbrush paint range from Green Stuff World. The promise? It really doesn't get much easier than this – just pour the paint straight from the bottle into the airbrush and go. Zero messing around with thinners or mixing ratios. But does it actually hold up in practice? And how do these paints stack up against Vallejo Game Air, Warpaints Air, and Green Stuff World's own Maxx Formula? I'll tell you all about it in this video.

### Addressing Green Stuff World's reputation first

First we need to address the elephant in the room: Green Stuff World is a company with a rather complicated past when it comes to the community. I prefer to keep things constructive on my channel, so you'll have to Google that yourself. This video is purely about the quality of the new airbrush range, no bias involved.
